simple.meaning: Bethuel , the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּתוּאֵל (H1328) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בְּתוּאֵל (Bᵉthûwʼêl) means Bethuel , the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 30.

definitions.short: Bethuel , the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1328. Bthuw 'el I. בְּתוּאֵל proper name, masculine (? = מְתוּאֵל man of God ) Gen 22:22-23 , 24:15 , 24 , 47 , 50 (J) son of Nahor, nephew of Abraham, living in Aram-Naharaim, in city of Nahor; 25:20 ; 28:2 , 5 (P) Aramaean of Paddan-Aramaic II. בְּתוּאֵל proper name, of a location in Simeon 1Chr 4:30 = בְּתוּל Josh 19:4 ; כְּסִיל 15:30 ; בֵּיתְאֵל 1Sam 30:27 (see above); yet compare Lag BN 64 ; site unknown. בְּתוּל see II. בְּתוּאֵל . above בִּתְיָה see בַּת below בן , p. 124. בָּֽתִּים see בית . בתל (compare Arabic sever, separate ).
definitions.rootNote: apparently from the same as 1326 and 410 ; destroyed of God;
